title: Vijay's 'Jana Nayagan' Review Sparks Debate Over Box Office Performance
summary: The film 'Jana Nayagan', starring Vijay, has been released and its box office performance is being discussed. The movie earned ₹125 crore in India on its fourth day of release, entering the ₹200 crore club worldwide. Fans celebrated Pongal in July for the film's release. The Quint reported that the film received mixed reviews from critics, while India Today highlighted the fans' celebrations and Republic World focused on the box office collection.
summary_points: The movie 'Jana Nayagan' was released and earned ₹125 crore in India on its fourth day of release.
The film entered the ₹200 crore club worldwide in its extended first weekend.
Fans celebrated Pongal in July for the film's release, as reported by India Today.
The Quint reported that the film received mixed reviews from critics.
Republic World focused on the box office collection of the film.
